carryon_bag_dimensions.value: Up to 55 x 40 x 23 cm (118 cm total); depth no more than 22 cm on Q300 aircraft
carryon_bag_dimensions.notes: Baggage page, "Carry-on allowances": "Maximum dimensions: 55 cm (L) x 40 cm (H) x 23cm (D)".

weight_economy.value: 1 carry-on bag up to 7 kg, plus 1 small personal item
weight_economy.notes: Baggage page: "Economy gets: 1 carry-on bag (7kg), plus 1 small personal item."

weight_premium_economy.value: 2 carry-on bags, 14 kg combined (no single bag over 10 kg), plus 1 small personal item
weight_premium_economy.notes: Baggage page: allowance shared by Premium Economy, Business Premier and Business Premier Luxe.

weight_business.value: 2 carry-on bags, 14 kg combined (no single bag over 10 kg), plus 1 small personal item (Business Premier and Business Premier Luxe)
weight_business.notes: Baggage page: allowance shared by Premium Economy, Business Premier and Business Premier Luxe.

personal_item.value: A small item that fits under the seat in front, such as a handbag, a thin laptop or tablet, or duty free goods

piece_weight_economy.value: International Economy: 1 bag; 2 bags between New Zealand or Australia and Shanghai or Singapore, New Zealand and Taipei, Australia and Canada or the USA (excluding New York), and Australia and Honolulu
piece_weight_economy.notes: Baggage page, "Checked-in baggage allowances by fare type" and its footnote. The long-haul economy page lists the same two-bag routes except Honolulu, which it does not mention.

piece_weight_premium_economy.notes: Baggage page, allowance table, international Premium Economy.

piece_weight_business.value: 3 bags (Business Premier and Business Premier Luxe)

size_weight.value: Each bag up to 23 kg (50 lb) and 158 cm total before extra fees apply; overweight bags are accepted up to 32 kg (70 lb)
size_weight.notes: Baggage page: "Each checked bag can weigh up to 23 kg (50 lb) and measure up to 158 cm in total dimensions before additional fees apply." Overweight section: "up to a maximum of 32 kg (70 lb)".

domestic_allowance.value: Within New Zealand: seat fares carry-on only; seat+bag 1 bag; flexirefund 2 bags (23 kg each)
domestic_allowance.notes: Baggage page allowance table, plus the domestic fares page for weights. "Seat-only fares include carry-on baggage only."

conflicting_values: One checked-in bag up to 23kg (domestic fares page)
domestic_flexichange_bags.notes: Two airnewzealand.com pages disagree on the domestic flexichange allowance, read 2026-10-05: https://www.airnewzealand.com/en-nz/travel-info/baggage and https://www.airnewzealand.com/domestic-fares. Neither is published.

fare_name.value: seat (within New Zealand): one carry-on bag up to 7 kg, no checked bag

seat_selection_included.value: Standard seat select from NZD $5; free for Koru Gold, Platinum and Black, Koru Nominees and Koru Club members

change_cancellation_policy.value: Date or time changes before departure cost NZD $60 per person (tickets issued from 10 Dec 2025), plus any fare difference; no refund on cancellation unless required by law
change_cancellation_policy.notes: Domestic fares page, seat fare: NZD $50 for tickets issued before 10 Dec 2025. Tasman/Pacific seat fares carry a $100 change fee (tasman-pacific-fare-rules-seat).

online_checkin_opens.notes: Online check-in page: "Online check-in is open 24 hours before the scheduled departure of your flight."

domestic_cutoff.value: 30 minutes before departure; 60 minutes when connecting to an international flight or for a child travelling alone
domestic_cutoff.notes: Domestic check-in page. Bag Drop also closes 30 minutes before domestic departures.

international_cutoff.value: 90 or 120 minutes before departure, depending on the flight
international_cutoff.notes: International check-in page: "Some flights close check-in 90 minutes before departure. Others can be 120 minutes beforehand."

boarding_close.notes: No gate-closing time is published on airnewzealand.com; Conditions of Carriage 9.2 says only to be at the gate "at the time we have stated".

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled

rebooking_refund.value: If Air New Zealand cancels or changes a flight, it may move you to another of its flights in the same class, another airline, or land or sea transport at no extra charge; if none of these works for you, you get a refund or a credit
rebooking_refund.notes: Conditions of Carriage (last updated 16 Mar 2026), section 8.2.

compensation_law.value: Compensation is paid as required by applicable law, including New Zealand's Civil Aviation Act 2023 and EU Regulation 261/2004
compensation_law.notes: Conditions of Carriage (last updated 16 Mar 2026), section 8.3.

duty_of_care_policy.notes: Overnight accommodation and meals are promised in the Customer Service & Tarmac Delay Plan, which says certain aspects apply only to US flights. Scope unclear; not published.

phone_home_market.notes: Phone numbers page, New Zealand section.

contact_help_centre.notes: Air New Zealand help and contact page.

conditions_of_carriage_url.notes: Conditions of Carriage (last updated 16 Mar 2026), linked from the legal terms page.
